layout_sources: https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/master/bank2ynab.conf [DE Consorsbank checking] (file name Umsatzübersicht_<9 digits>, semicolon, one header row, %d.%m.%Y; its 8 columns are the format before Kategorie/Stichwörter/Umsatz geteilt were added)
notes: Umsatzübersicht CSV: one header row, semicolons, dd.mm.yyyy, Buchung and Valuta, the counterparty with IBAN/BIC, Buchungstext and Verwendungszweck, then Kategorie, Stichwörter and "Umsatz geteilt" (added to the older 8-column file when categories came in), and a signed "Betrag in EUR" in German number format. Windows-1252, CRLF, newest first and the thousands mark are assumed. Column names after Verwendungszweck are from memory of user reports, not a source checked here. No balance.
